citations.assessment: Acha son of Chiyya bar Abba reports Chiyya from Yochanan. Both of Heilprin’s corrections remain conjectural against the wording of this digital witness.
The reciprocal dossier gives the Abba form and attributes a separate transmission to Yonatan in Vayikra Rabbah.
The witness spells out Rav Acha son of Rav Chiyya; the patronym and addressee do not settle Heilprin’s question about identity.
